dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetrical narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior limit of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minimal; lateral margins are largely smooth with a subtle convex deviation on the left side mid-body.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with high median pixel intensity and soft grey shading along the lateral flanks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One high-contrast, dark, heart-shaped mark located on the dorsal midline posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct dark focal lesion or mark behind the blowhole; several faint, narrow longitudinal lines visible on the lower dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The unique heart-shaped geometry of the dark pigmented mark on the anterior dorsal surface.
